summary: Unlock the secrets of contract drafting with our expert-led training for non-lawyers. Equip yourself with the skills to navigate legal documents successfully.
lede: Contract drafting helps non-lawyers turn business requirements into clear agreement terms and manage contract risks. For professionals who work with contracts but lack formal legal training, the course covers organizing agreements, defining measurable deliverables and acceptance criteria, and drafting payment, variation, and termination clauses. Learners also practice identifying risky wording, negotiating changes, and explaining obligations to stakeholders through clause rewrites and contract exercises.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly engage with contracts but lack formal legal training. It empowers you to confidently manage contract terms, protect your business from legal risk, and negotiate safer terms without weakening protection. The course is ideal for: Procurement Manager:
audience: Draft and review vendor service agreements
Project Lead: define deliverables, timelines, and acceptance
Operations Supervisor: manage contractor performance using SLAs
Business Owner: draft enforceable service contracts
Consultant: structure client agreements with balanced payment
HR Manager: create employment and contractor agreements
Startup Founder: negotiate vendor and client contracts
modules: Structure and Organization of Business Contracts
Drafting Clear Scopes of Work and Deliverables
Core Clauses: Payment, Variation, and Termination
Risk Identification and Mitigation in Contract Terms
Performance Management: SLAs, KPIs, and Remedies
prerequisites: Participants should have basic business experience and regular exposure to contracts. Familiarity with common business terms (e.g., payment, delivery, liability) is helpful but not mandatory. No legal background or coding skills are required. Participants are encouraged to bring a real contract they have used or seen for analysis during drafting exercises.
